open_points.subject: _encrypt_backup
open_points.text: _encrypt_backup: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST seal under an AES-GCM key of the imported BACKUP_KEY_BYTES constant in bytes, derived by HKDF with the hash algorithm of the cryptography package whose name is the one the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant holds, found by that name and never through hash names written in the code, and no salt from the bytes of backup_key with those of the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_INFO constant as its info, both encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, using the cryptography package, and MUST pass the record line's bytes without its line feed as the associated data, so that a changed record fails the decryption.
open_points.other_text:
Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; a declared field or operation is
  addressed by its name, including in try/finally cleanup, and a
  model's fields read generically come from iterating the model,
  in place or inside an imported operation that does so.
open_points.question: Must the note permit an explicit mapping or statically named cryptography hash constructors, or must the gate permit reflective lookup of the algorithm named by BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH?
